reason: Why pay over ₹20,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and already handle our day-to-day workflow? Even with the stress of Saturday GST reconciliations and July ITR rushes with rotating article clerks, I am not spending that kind of money when our existing routine costs nothing.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, especially when my team would still have to manually forward WhatsApp files and adopt another interface?
would_change_my_mind: If testing the free pilot completely eliminates my two-hour Saturday GST reconciliation and proves my article clerks consistently follow maker-checker checklists without my supervision.
